dtk.text: Kolaghan's reign began with the Khanfall, when each khan fell with their clan and five dragon clans rose under the dragonlords.
Under Kolaghan the Mardu name was forgotten and the group became clan Kolaghan, and she joined the ban on the word khan and the old clan names.
Zurgo, once the Mardu khan of another timeline, served as her bell-striker, and a Kolaghan dragon dived at Anafenza but was torn apart by a bolt of golden light made of spirits.

Kolaghan's brood fought on the frontline in the New Phyrexian Invasion and drove out the Phyrexians but suffered heavy losses, and later rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and defeated Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords.
